comparison.reasoned_mask: finite AND first-row-zero excluded AND R_percent<=100; exclusions retain row-level reason
comparison.split: ordered continuous windows; never random adjacent-point split
comparison.budget: one deterministic run per material-angle-window-mask plus 144 synthetic cases (432 model-runs); no tuning after observed outputs
comparison.stopping_rule: finish fixed grid once; no adaptive expansion

synthetic_calibration.note: dimensionless algorithmic calibration grid; not a claimed material refractive index or true sample thickness

thresholds.improvement_supported: median synthetic error at least 20% below B, win rate >=0.75, and observed cross-window/dual-angle/mask diagnostics do not degrade by >10% relative to B
thresholds.inconclusive: numerical gain exists but support, stability, or identifiability condition is not met
thresholds.unsupported: no targeted gain or a rejection rule is triggered
thresholds.M_gate: mechanism evidence must be stable across both angles, at least two windows and both masks AND a stable >=5% conditional optical-thickness effect must be estimable; otherwise no admission

truth_limit: Observed data have no independent thickness truth. Report q=n*d*cos(theta1) or d(n), never a unique physical n or true thickness.
